fact: On Thursday 19 June 2025 the Director General of National Security launched work with the WAPIS police information system for central directors, the regional directors of the Nouakchott wilayas, central commissioners and heads of judicial police sections in commissariats; the programme, supervised by the Central Office for collecting police information at the Judicial Police Directorate, aims to digitise the work of police commissariats and to document reports (بلاغات) and complaints (شكايات) at commissariats and their offices, its roll-out had reached 90% in the commissariats of Nouakchott, and the office was linked to 27 National Police centres, 7 National Gendarmerie centres and 2 Customs centres.
title: المدير العام للأمن يطلق نظام WAPIS الألكتروني لتوثيق ورقمنة عمل الشرطة
